text.description_html:
Fusion PH-A3, River Rock Collection Scalloped Toilet Tissue Holder

The Arched Mount Toilet Paper Holder has a rustic feel that stems from its classic shape and old world finish choices. Choose from medium bronze or dark bronze finishes. The scalloped wall mounted toilet tissue holder is from Fusion's River Rock collection which is known for its simple beauty. This bathroom toilet paper holder is easy to install and comes with all the necessary mounting hardware.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-A3 Arched Towel Bar, Fusion TR-A3 Arched Towel Ring, and Fusion RH-A3 Arched Robe Hook

Features and Specifications of the Fusion Arched Wall Mounted Toilet Paper Holder:

  • Mount Width: 2-7/8"
  • Mount Length: 3-5/8"
  • Reversible to hang in either direction.
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
